name: Miss Whan
source: 75 years old and Ryo’s high school biology teacher. She has been a teacher for 40 years and is growing rather tired of it. She pushes Ryo to try and do his best, though she has ill feelings towards his father, and assumes Ryo will go down the same path as him. She is professional, uptight, and difficult to get along with.
